info.name: Rafael Antonio Hidalgo Romero
info.post: Full stack developer and technology consultant with DYNAMIC_EXPERIENCE_YEARS years of experience in large-scale development, specialized in microservices architectures, distributed systems, and cloud solutions.

workitems.descrip:
Technology consulting and development for international enterprise clients, owning the full delivery cycle of each account.
• Millicom (TIGO): serverless services on AWS Lambda and Zendesk development with React. Zendesk to Chatwoot migration across 9 countries, using Vue.js and Ruby on Rails.
• Copa Airlines: Five9 scripting to improve contact-center voice integration.
• Rosen: microservices in Spring Boot and CI/CD pipeline management on Azure DevOps.
• Abcdin: backend in Node.js, TypeScript and NestJS, with SQS consumers for asynchronous processing on AWS.
Technologies: Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, React.js, Vue.js, Ruby on Rails, Spring Boot, Java, AWS Lambda, SQS, Azure DevOps.

Technologies: Golang, Python, Docker, SQL, REST API, batch processing.

info.aboutme:
I'm Rafael, a full stack developer and technology consultant with DYNAMIC_EXPERIENCE_YEARS years of experience creating innovative solutions for international companies. I specialize in microservices architectures, distributed systems, and cloud technologies, having worked with clients like Millicom (TIGO), Copa Airlines, and Rosen on large-scale projects.

My passion lies in transforming complex ideas into robust and scalable systems. I have experience leading development teams from conceptualization to implementation, using technologies like Node.js, Golang, React, Vue.js, and AWS and Azure platforms.

I enjoy tackling technical challenges that require creative solutions, especially in high-concurrency systems, REST APIs, and complex integrations. My goal is always to deliver real value through clean code, solid architectures, and effective collaboration.
